codeReview.summary: Documentation updates to ARCHITECTURE.md are mostly accurate. All required changes were made: file paths fixed from Windows URLs to relative paths, OCR and Activity Feed endpoints added to Source of Truth, payment approval push notification documented. One minor discrepancy: OCR error handling documented as 503 but implementation returns 500.

issues.description: GEMINI_API_KEY error handling documented as returning 503, but actual implementation in backend/internal/handlers/ocr.go returns HTTP 500 (Internal Server Error). Per AGENTS.md guidelines, this should either: (a) document the actual behavior (500), or (b) note this as a code bug requiring backend change. The 503 status is semantically more appropriate for missing configuration, but documentation should match implementation or explicitly flag the discrepancy.
